system.description:
Acquired with CR16 or higher. Deal [(SRx2)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target.

(Target: Dazed, Rigor, Staggered): Increase the damage by +[INT base].

A special skill that is worthy of the name of curtain puller, and unleashes a full blow with loud accompaniment. A splendid technique that fascinates those who see it, if it hits directly, it will surely tell the end of the enemy.
